dsma-journey-map.details: Pair exercise: buyer persona, risk level, purchase probability and at least 5 SMART recommendations per EV category. Practice submission, not graded.
dsma-journey-map.title: D&SMA practice submission: customer journey map

ei-gtm-plan.details: Handwritten plan of about 350 words covering go-to-market, marketing, funding and user acquisition.
ei-gtm-plan.title: E&I: 350-word handwritten go-to-market plan

imc-cia1-usha.details: In-class group assignment in the Monday IMC slot. Join the IMC Google Classroom first, because the CIA 1 submission goes through it. AI tools are allowed.
imc-cia1-usha.title: IMC CIA 1: group assignment on the 1972 Usha ad

imc_persona.details: AI or real photo plus an alliterative adjective title, describing you as a person and a consumer.
imc_persona.title: IMC: consumer persona posted to the WhatsApp group

rtm-cia1-part1.details: Pick one product and compare its price and value-added services across 5 physical stores, then write a report. Quick-commerce apps do not count. Taken up in the Friday RTM class.
rtm-cia1-part1.title: RTM CIA 1 Part 1: price and service comparison across 5 stores

rtm-cia1-part2.details: Visit one Exclusive Brand Outlet and write a report on 10 products in it. Due date not announced yet.
rtm-cia1-part2.title: RTM CIA 1 Part 2: EBO report on 10 products

rtm-home-visit.details: Visit a retail area, interview people there about the practices retailers follow, and share what you find in class. Due date not announced yet.
rtm-home-visit.title: RTM home assignment: retail area visit and interviews

sbm-cia1-mindmap.details: Groups of up to 5, one B2C brand. Build Map A from open questions and Map B from a structured questionnaire, mark each association as strong, unique, positive or negative, then recommend what the brand should change or reinforce. Due date not announced yet.
sbm-cia1-mindmap.title: SBM CIA 1: aided and unaided brand mind maps
